title: Worldhewn: a single-player MMO-style RPG built with Claude + Godot (trailer)
author: travisrd
selftext:
Godot 4 and GDScript for the engine

Claude Code for vast majority of the code, between opus 5.5 and fable 5.2 medium/high

Suno for the trailer music; the in-game audio is synthesized in the project

The trailer itself was captured and cut by Claude too, using Godot’s movie mode and ffmpeg, with the cuts matched to the beat of the track

  
Worldhewn is a voxel/pixel rpg that play like an old-school mmo, except its single-player.  Populated by AI players who will chat, group with you, guild, do their own tasks and travel along side you.  The world is huge and honestly a bit overwhelming

I have the feedback system buitd into the game now so its been pretty easy to keep track of bugs/changes as people play.  Theres still so much work to be done but so far has absolutely been a blast learning different tools

[https://worldhewngame.com](https://worldhewngame.com)
